title: Upgrade in rating from S&P
body_markdown:
**Buenos Aires, June 12, 2026.** Pampa Energía S.A. (‘Pampa’ or the ‘Company’; NYSE: PAM; ByMA: PAMP) announces that today, S&P upgraded Pampa’s long-term foreign and local currency ratings from ‘B-’ to ‘B’ with stable outlook.
